title: Prediction of Breast Cancer Histological Outcome by Radiomics and Artificial Intelligence Analysis in Contrast-Enhanced Mammography.
summary: Contrast-enhanced mammography radiomics with machine learning predicted pathology-confirmed malignancy and histological features in breast lesions. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: The study uses a the machine-learning model evaluated in this study for the stated prediction of breast cancer histological outcome by radiomics and artificial intelligence analysis in contrast-enhanced mammography task.
